name: Submify Self-Hosted Form Backend
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0-licensed self-hosted form submission backend with Docker Compose, PostgreSQL dashboard, project submission inbox, XLSX/PDF exports, client portals and optional Telegram notifications. No software subscription or time-limited license; usage depends on your own server and configured rate limits.
watch_out: Requires self-managed Docker hosting, PostgreSQL and security/backup maintenance. SMTP email, external S3-compatible storage and hosting may cost extra; not a free hosted form API. AGPL-3.0 obligations apply, including source disclosure for modified network-served versions. Form UI must be built separately; no drag-and-drop form builder.
